def starts_one_ends(n):
    if n == 1:
        return 1
    # Count numbers that start with 1 and have (n-1) digits remaining
    start_with_1 = 9**(n-1)
    # Count numbers that end with 1 and have (n-1) digits remaining
    end_with_1 = 9**(n-1)
    # Subtract double-counted numbers that start and end with 1
    start_and_end_with_1 = 9**(n-2)
    return start_with_1 + end_with_1 - start_and_end_with_1
